limitations: application layer only: no HTTP hop, no network RTT, no server scheduling
no real frontend wait or edit-lock window is measured
request/response bytes are canonical JSON bodies without HTTP headers
runs use in-process synthetic node executors; no package files, no tools, no model calls
unknown-result path is measured through the read-only receipt verification; no post-commit fault injection was used for a simulated lost response
history/q08 cases build their fixtures once per size and are not repeated for timing

chain.note: five serial application calls of one initialized normal save; one additional request-evidence.read initializes the channel on its first use

chain-narrow.note: S4-01 flow: one owner-scoped pending summary (no pending on the normal path), then write, point confirm, business, point confirm, resolve; compare with `chain` which reads the owner's full history

chain-history.note: the owner already holds 100 verified evidence rows of the same document size; baseline = full owner read for init + both confirms, narrow = one owner pending summary + two point reads

config.note: one-node document; modification-busy holds the step-1 process gate in this process and measures the immediate 409; the R1 read-only replay probe runs once per new modification and is reported separately

error.message: Document edit sequence differs from its editing basis

history.note: each row builds a real fixed-revision history, then measures one display-only, one fixed and one unchanged save at that history size; the fixed case shows the first save-time scan plus the second MAX scan that Q08 may remove, while the first scan stays and keeps growing with history

evidence.note: owner evidence rows are verified historical rows plus at most one pending row; `full_owner_read` is the pre-S4-01 read and `narrow_reads` are the S4-01 owner summary / point / pending reads on the same data

q08.note: corrupt rows are appended directly to isolated temp copies; product database untouched; this is the behaviour baseline Q08 must not change silently
